create_Sam3Processor: create a Sam3Processor instance with a model, resolution, device, and confidence threshold for SAM3 image grounding
run_set_image: run set_image on a PIL image or tensor to extract backbone features and prepare inference state
run_set_text_prompt: run set_text_prompt with a text string to perform zero-shot object detection on a previously set image
run_add_geometric_prompt: run add_geometric_prompt with a [center_x, center_y, width, height] box and positive label to detect objects at a location
run_set_image_batch: run set_image_batch on a list of PIL images to process multiple images and extract backbone features
run_reset_all_prompts: run reset_all_prompts to clear all prompts, masks, boxes, and scores from the inference state
run_set_confidence_threshold: run set_confidence_threshold to filter detection results by a new probability threshold
